title: sao SEC0: no critical correctness bugs found
description:
SEC0 correctness review complete:
✓ escape_xml() is correct: escapes & first, covers all 5 XML chars (&<>"')
✓ validate_group_name() correctly rejects path traversal (../../../etc/passwd, slashes, etc.)
✓ Pagination logic is correct: effective_low = high - (limit - 1) fetches exactly N most recent articles
✓ RSS and Atom XML output is well-formed with correct namespace declarations
✓ All user-supplied fields (subject, from, message_id, date, group) are escaped before output
✓ No unsafe generation paths identified

One P1 risk identified separately: ETag header safety with special chars.
